She is wearing a light-colored dress with black polka dots and has her hair styled in loose waves. The dress is tied at the waist, and she is barefoot. She holds a smartphone in her right hand, which is capturing the photo. The living room features contemporary decor. There is a white sectional sofa with striped cushions on the left side of the image. A small round wooden table is placed in front of the sofa. On the right side, there is a yellow armchair with a beige cushion
